sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: cAMP luminescence concentration-response to sotolone measured for both N-terminal tag variants; functional surface expression confirmed for both constructs relative to empty-plasmid (Mock) control — function preserved.
sites.rationale: All three ledger clips (L1, L2, L3) from PMC6706140 describe the same junction: an N-terminal tag prepended to full-length OR8D1. The canonical topology (authoritative landmarks) assigns residues 1–24 as extracellular with no signal peptide (raw topology begins with 'O', not 'S'), so 'N-terminal' unambiguously resolves to insert_after_residue=0 (before M1). Python verification confirms seq[0]='M' and the first TM boundary begins at residue 25, leaving 24 extracellular residues between the tag and the membrane — ample room for a ~15–23 aa insert. L1 is cited as the primary clip because it introduces both tag variants and the functional surface-expression result; L2 and L3 corroborate with explicit cAMP assay data. Full-length OR8D1 expressed in a heterologous system with two distinct N-terminal fusion tags (IL-6-HaloTag and Rho-tag-HaloTag); concentration-response relations to the odorant sotolone were measured by cAMP-dependent luminescence assay, and data were normalized to the maximum amplitude of the IL-6-HaloTag-OR8D1 construct.

sources.claim: Example result of a concentration-response relation of sotolone on OR8D1, equipped with different N-terminal tags.

literature_notes: Three ledger clips (L1, L2, L3) all originate from the same publication (PMC6706140) and all describe the identical junction — an N-terminal prepend on full-length OR8D1. They are treated as one site with L1 as the primary supporting clip. No ledger evidence exists for any internal extracellular loop (ECL1: 80–97, ECL2: 165–196, ECL3: 261–274) or for the C-terminal intracellular tail; no sites are proposed there. The two tag types cited (IL-6-HaloTag and Rho-tag-HaloTag) are both N-terminal fusions; no residue number is stated in any clip, so position_evidence is topology_derived rather than validated.
